title: PersonNode
description: An extensive representation of a Person — human or digital persona — used to gather data about an individual person. Nearly every field is optional so partial profiles remain valid; the object is designed to be filled in progressively over time.

confidence.description: 0..1 confidence that this value is accurate / current.

sourceType.description: Evidence class used by the source discipline policy. Primary/direct evidence should generally outrank inferred or third-party evidence.

confidenceTier.description: Actionability tier: high can drive personalization, medium should keep fallback options, low is only a weak ranking hint.

currentStatus.description: Whether this value should be treated as current for operational decisions.

fieldCriticality.description: Risk if the field is wrong. Critical fields require recent high-strength evidence before action.

timeScope.description: Explicit temporal boundary for facts that may change.

context.description: Situation where this time scope applies.

evidencePointer.description: Traceable evidence backing a field or claim.

producedBy.description: Person, system, institution, or device that produced the evidence.

quoteOrSpan.description: Exact supporting span or compact explanation of how this was obtained.

hash.description: Optional content hash for provenance-controlled storage.

confidenceAssessment.description: Per-field confidence calculation from evidence strength and freshness.

methodRisk.description: 0 means low method risk; 1 means high ambiguity/inference risk.

claim.description: Evidence-first graph claim. Update claims and evidence links rather than overwriting the person node blindly.

path.description: JSON Pointer or dotted path to the field this claim supports.

conflictRecord.description: Detected disagreement between claims or evidence records.

auditEntry.description: Append-only audit trail entry for updates, merges, reviews, and publications.

preferenceItem.description: Context-aware positive or negative preference for customization.

capabilityItem.description: Current capability or readiness field with evidence, confirmation date, and operational requirements.

trait.description: A single measured tendency with strength and confidence.

measurementInstrument.description: Validated scale, rubric, or taxonomy used to define/score this trait.

bodyMarking.description: A tattoo, piercing, scar, birthmark, or other mark on the body. Whether visible or not, self inflicted or not.

abilityCondition.description: A disability, medical condition, neurodivergence, or learning difference and its impact.

aidsUsed.description: Wheelchair, hearing aid, screen reader, prosthetic, service animal, etc.

accommodations.description: Support the person needs from the service/environment.

disclosed.description: Whether the person has openly disclosed this.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for this person node.

system.description: Machine/graph metadata — how this node exists inside the service, not who the person is.

role.description: Role of this node within the service or mission.

trust.description: Trust the service places in this node (0..1).

sourceEntityId.description: Origin entity that produced this node.

asOf.description: Timestamp for the published node snapshot.

dataFreshnessWindow.description: Default period in which fields are considered current unless they define a stricter window.

currentScope.description: Definition of 'current' for this node, e.g. 'today', 'last_30_days', or a service-specific policy id.

dataCompleteness.description: How fully this profile is populated (0..1).

identity.description: Names, demographics, and the 'me' the person presents to the world.

birthTime.description: Local time of birth, HH:MM if known.

age.description: Derived; store only if not computing from birthDate.

sex.description: Biological sex if distinct from gender identity.

identityNames.description: Evidence-backed name variants used for identity resolution.

identityLinkageStatus.description: How sure the system is that records belong to this person, not a namesake or neighboring entity.

self.description: Self-concept & narrative identity — the 'me' the person inhabits.

selfConcept.description: 'Who I am' in their own terms.

lifeStory.description: Major turning points and their interpretation.

socialRoles.description: parent, student, partner, citizen, worker, etc.

continuityNarrative.description: How past-self, present-self, and future-self are linked.

items.description: What goals are important to them.

timeHorizon.description: How long they envision living, is the person future oriented, or dwelling on the past, or present in the present?

personalOutlook.description: How does the person view the world, society, their family, tribe, nation, etc.

physical.description: Embodiment — the body the person lives in.

bodyArt.description: Tattoos, piercings, scars, birthmarks, and other body markings.

distinguishingFeatures.description: Free-text notable features (dimples, gap teeth, prosthetic, etc.) not captured elsewhere.

differences.description: Ability profile — disabilities, neurodivergence, learning/remedial differences, and how the person functions. Distinct from transient chronic conditions.

conditions.description: Structured disabilities/differences, e.g. paraplegia, amputation, dyslexia, autism, ADHD.

aids.description: Wheelchair, cane, walker, crutches, prosthetic limb, etc.

neurodivergence.description: Autism, ADHD, dyslexia, dyscalculia, Tourette's, etc.

assistiveTech.description: Screen reader, captions, voice control, magnifier, hearing aid, etc.

supportNeeds.description: General accommodations the service should honor.

perceptionAttention.description: What tends to be noticed vs ignored.

style.description: What is remembered/forgotten and how it is stored/recalled.

imagination.description: Ability to model futures and possibilities. Also how they deal with uncertainty. Ones ability to envision ambiguous objects and abstract concepts.

emotionalRegulation.description: How they calm, reframe, or escalate.

mbti.description: Optional 4-letter type if the person uses this framework.

traits.description: Free-form personality traits (replaces the old personality1..19 slots).

habitsAndDefaults.description: What they typically do before they think.

consistencyAcrossContexts.description: Whether they stay the same or shift by situation.

coreValues.description: truth, freedom, family, beauty, faith, fairness, etc.

moralOrientation.description: How right/wrong and harm are judged.

beliefSystem.description: How beliefs are formed, updated, and defended.

agencyCharacter.description: How the person acts over time.

willpower.description: Following long-term goals over short-term impulses.

responsibilityPractices.description: Owning mistakes, making amends, planning ahead.

trustAndBoundaries.description: How they decide whom to let in.

aestheticSense.description: What they find beautiful or expressive.

originality.description: How novel their solutions/narratives tend to be.

capacityForChange.description: Ability to learn new patterns and revise identity.

growthMindset.description: How they approach learning and change.

background.description: Life context that shapes but isn't the person themselves.

optomoleProfile.description: Everything Optomole needs to highly customize this person's experience.

goals.description: What they want and expect to receive from the Optomoles' services.

tone.description: How Optomoles' service should speak to them.

evidenceGraph.description: Evidence-first claim graph used to build, verify, de-duplicate, and update this Person Node.

resolvedFields.description: Published field resolutions with an explicit winner, fallback, or dispute state.

chronology.description: Event-based timeline to avoid treating past facts as current status.

currentState.description: Fields optimized for current-status customization and service delivery.

accessRequirements.description: Requirements needed for successful delivery, such as device type, bandwidth, language level, or accessibility support.

criticalConstraints.description: High-impact restrictions. If not recent and high-confidence, services should use generic safe options or request confirmation.

contextTags.description: Time-scoped relationship or situation context used for customization.

behavioralRecentSignals.description: Recent behavioral signals for recommendation mechanics. These are evidence for trends, not absolute claims about intent.

governance.description: Operational controls for confidence calibration, human review, de-duplication, publishing, and re-verification.

formula.description: Example: confidence_score = evidenceStrength * freshnessFactor, capped by disputes and method risk.

provenance.description: Meta about the data itself — for auditing how the profile was built.

sourceRegistry.description: Canonical source inventory used by evidence pointers.

calibration.description: Periodic hindsight checks for whether high-confidence claims proved correct.
